title: World's worst video card? The exciting conclusion
summary: Ben Eater finishes building a minimal VGA video card from logic circuits. He explains analog RGB signals, stores an image in an EEPROM and builds a simple digital-to-analog converter to display it.
why: Recommended as an accessible, educational build that anyone with basic logic knowledge can follow.

quote.text: Anyone with a basic understanding of logic circuits has enough background to understand it. Worth a watch.
